# Agent instructions

See README.md (structure, privacy model, commands) and docs/architecture.md.

Hard rules:
- Never add survey data, names, phone numbers, respondent IDs or exact farm locations to this
  repository. Survey data lives only in the private data store (RESOLVE_PRIVATE_DATA).
- `public/data` is generated by `python -m resolve build`; do not edit it by hand.
- Field meanings, answer codes and privacy classes are defined only in `dictionary/*.yaml`.
- The frontend (`public/js`) must stay generic: no layer or dataset names in code; describe
  layers in the catalog instead.
- Run `python -m pytest` before committing; the privacy tests are build-breaking.
